test_objective: Check that you can update entity attributes

test_cases.name: 011_01_01 Check that you can update existing attributes with no datasetId
test_cases.doc: Check that you can update entity attributes
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-speed-two-datasetid-01-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
